style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Instant harmonious symmetry this Christmas season and beyond with these two HOMCOM artificial 4ft trees. Both trees have 864 tips, with 85% of the branches moulded from real branches, making them lifelike. Made from plastic for extended use, the fire-retardant materials ensure safety in the home. With 100 LED lights on each tree for beautiful ambience in the dark, they are complete with vintage boxy bases. Single package contains two artificial 4ft Christmas trees. Use together in the home or office, or alone. Each tree is pre-lit with 100 warm white LEDs, looking beautiful in the dark and energy-saving. 85% tips are moulded from real branches with three different types, featuring 864 tips for full, lifelike trees. Distressed vintage-inspired pots are included for each tree to stand. Made from flame-retardant materials for safety. Bendable branches on a two-section pole allow for easy setup with custom shaping. Colour: Green. Material: Plastic, Steel. Overall Dimension: F85 x 120H cm. Base Dimension: 18L x 18W x 25H cm. Branch Tips: 864. Light Count: 100 (Warm White). Cord Length: 2 m. Input: AC 220-240V, 50-60Hz. Output: DC 31V, 3.6W. Suggest Assembly Time: 20-30 minutes. Item Label: 83C-115V71GN. NOTE: Only for indoor or covered outdoor use, not for uncovered outdoor.
